post.title: [HIRING] - Paid Short-form UGC Video Editor (remote)
post.body:
Looking for an editor for ongoing short-form UGC content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts).

* Around 7 vids a day (would take around ~2 hours)
* simple edits: cuts, captions, hooks, music, sometimes b-roll
* paid monthly, ongoing work if it goes well
* fast turnaround and consistency matter more than fancy effects (fancy edits are not needed)

To apply, DM me with:

1. 2-3 short form edits you've done or your portfolio
2. your time zone and turnaround time

Compensation:

* $300-400/month, can be negotiable ($2 a video)

There's a small paid test edit before we start.

These videos are typically 30 seconds to a minute long and do not require much work. I am preferably looking for an editor who has previous experience working as a (Canvas) UGC video editor.

NO AI VIDEOS ARE NEEDED.

analysis.summary: Looking for a remote short-form UGC video editor for ongoing daily content.

expect: gives what the post asks for in the DM: the work link for short-form edits and the user's time zone (from the profile, India), with only one link
mentions short-form cuts, captions and fast turnaround matching the 7-videos-a-day workflow, and does not claim Canvas UGC experience
does not invent a turnaround time or availability hours
